analysis_status: Specified before computing Phase 3 tests and confidence intervals. Exploratory analyses informed by Phase 1 and Phase 2 descriptions of the same extract.

hypothesis_test.role: Supplementary omnibus cross-modal comparison across cognitive groups
hypothesis_test.null: All four mean thicknesses are equal
hypothesis_test.alternative: At least one mean thickness differs
hypothesis_test.effect: Group means and descriptive sample eta-squared, computed from sums of squares
hypothesis_test.diagnostics: Review each group's size, distribution, spread and extreme values. Keep the seven-person impairment-without-MCI group with an explicit precision limitation.

method.name: Welch one-way ANOVA
method.p_value: Upper-tail F probability, scipy.stats.f.sf(F, k - 1, df2)
method.mean_intervals: Separate Student t intervals for the group means
method.assumptions: Independent participants and approximate normal-theory calibration within groups. Unequal population variances and unequal group sizes are allowed. The seven-person group has limited precision and weak protection from a large-sample approximation.

descriptive_effect.definition: Between-group sum of squares divided by total sum of squares in the observed sample
descriptive_effect.interpretation: A descriptive share of observed squared thickness variation associated with differences among group means. It depends on sample composition and is separate from Welch's precision-weighted F statistic.

diagnostics.review: Review group counts, ranges, quartiles, SDs, skewness, IQR flags and the group-specific normal Q-Q plots. Keep all measurements outside review fences.
diagnostics.small_group: The impairment-without-MCI group has seven participants. Its mean interval and Welch approximation are sensitive to departures from normality and individual extreme values.
diagnostics.normality: The empirical skewness and Q-Q plots describe tail asymmetry. Welch does not remove sensitivity to non-normal observations in small groups; the test is a model-based exploratory comparison.

interpretation.omnibus: Rejection supports a difference in at least one population mean under the model assumptions. It does not identify a particular pair of groups.
interpretation.effect: Report group means and intervals in millimeters alongside descriptive sample eta-squared.
interpretation.confidence_interval: Under repeated sampling with the stated assumptions, a nominal 95% procedure covers the target population parameter in about 95% of repeated samples.
interpretation.generalization: The sampling frame and selection probabilities are undocumented. Confidence intervals depend on the sampling assumptions and the stated eligibility rules.
interpretation.scope: An unadjusted exploratory comparison; age, sex and education are addressed in Phase 4.
